limitations: Local Docker Desktop, not cloud or host-level HA
Load generator shares Docker VM with services
Other local containers remain running; contention is not eliminated
Images built before this experiment; recorded image IDs define tested artifacts, not an assumed HEAD rebuild
No extra paid resources; resource cost is CPU/memory allocation, not measured cloud billing

aggregation: Median of three per-run measurements; p95 is median of per-run p95, not pooled p95. Booking HTTP throughput includes POST plus receipt GET.

recovery.definition: First 30s window, sampled at 1s offsets from stop request, with traffic in every second, error rate <1% and each operation p95 <3000ms. Completion timestamps; local experiment only.
